Rashi on Megillah 11a:10:1.hebrew: [הדא דכתיב כו'] - מה שכתב בתורה "ואין קונה", גזר המן שלא יהא אדם רשאי לקנות מהן לעבד:
Rashi on Megillah 11a:10:1.english: [This is as it is written, etc.] - [Regarding] that which is written in the Torah, "and there is no buyer" — Haman decreed that no person would be permitted to buy any of them as a slave:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:11:1.hebrew: ושמואל אמר מהכא - פתחא, "לא מאסתים" וגו':
Rashi on Megillah 11a:11:1.english: And Shmuel said from here - [He gave his] introduction [from the verse], "I will not reject them," etc.:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:13:1.english: And if you do not drive out, etc. - These too were punished because Saul had pity on Amalek:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:14:1.english: I shall do unto you - These [Jews] too almost perished:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:15:1.english: The brother of the head - That is to say, [he is] similar to him:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:15:2.hebrew: בן גילו - בן מזלו, שניהן דעת אחת היה להן:
Rashi on Megillah 11a:15:2.english: Of the same character [ben gilo] - Of his same fortune [ben mazalo]; the two of them were of one mind:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:15:3.hebrew: בקש להחריב - יסוד שיסד זרובבל בבית המקדש בימי כורש לפני אחשורוש, כמו שאמור בספר עזרא (סימן ד'):
Rashi on Megillah 11a:15:3.english: [He] sought to destroy - the foundation that Zerubbabel laid in the Temple in the days of Cyrus, before Ahasuerus, as is stated in the Book of Ezra (chapter 4):

Rashi on Megillah 11a:15:4.hebrew: שטנה - שנמנה לשטן להם, שלא יבנוהו:
Rashi on Megillah 11a:15:4.english: An accusation - [meaning] that he was appointed to be an adversary to them, so that they would not build it [the Temple]:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:18:1.english: Abram, this is Abraham - It is a verse in Chronicles:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:19:1.english: That he reigned on his own - [meaning] that he was not of royal lineage:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:1:1.hebrew: כי עבדים אנחנו - פסוק הוא בספר עזרא, וסיפא: "ויט עלינו חסד לפני שרי פרס לתת עלינו מחיה":
Rashi on Megillah 11a:1:1.english: For we are bondmen - It is a verse in the Book of Ezra, and the end [of the verse is]: "and He extended mercy unto us before the princes of Persia, to give us revival":

Rashi on Megillah 11a:21:1.english: For he had dominion - [this] is written regarding Solomon:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:21:2.hebrew: כשם שמלך על תפסח ועל עזה וכו' - והכי קאמר: "כי הוא רודה בכל עבר הנהר", כמו "מתפסח ועד עזה":
Rashi on Megillah 11a:21:2.english: Just as he reigned over Tiphsah and over Gaza, etc. - And this is what [the verse] is saying: "For he had dominion over all the region on this side of the river" — just as [he had dominion] "from Tiphsah even to Gaza."

Rashi on Megillah 11a:23:1.english: Ruled in the dome - [Meaning] beneath the entire dome of the firmament:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:24:1.english: As we have said - [that he ruled] from Hodu to Kush:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:2:1.english: Through fire, in the days of Nebuchadnezzar - for he cast us into the furnace:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:3:1.hebrew: אימתי ראו כל אפסי ארץ את ישועת אלהינו בימי מרדכי - שהדבר נגלה לכל האומות, שהלכו אגרות בכל העולם:
Rashi on Megillah 11a:3:1.english: When did all the ends of the earth see the salvation of our God? In the days of Mordecai - for the matter was revealed to all the nations, as letters went out throughout the entire world:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:6:1.english: The enemy of the Holy One, Blessed be He, became poor - As one who was unable to save [them]:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:7:1.english: A man and not a king - This is Haman:

Rashi on Megillah 11a:9:1.english: Rav Mattana [said] from here - [He] opened [with] an introductory exposition:

Tosafot on Megillah 11a:23:1.hebrew: שלשה מלכו בכל העולם כולו - והא דלא חשיב אלכסנדר מוקדון, משום דלא איירי הכא אלא באותם הכתובים להדיא:
Tosafot on Megillah 11a:23:1.english: Three ruled over the entire world - And as for why [the Gemara] did not count Alexander of Macedon, [it is] because here it only speaks of those who are explicitly written [in Scripture]:
